NONE: › also do's and don'ts rules about actions and activities that people should or should not perform or take part in
規定，規則；規矩
› abbreviation for disk operating system: a type of operating system for computers
（電腦）磁碟操作系統（disk operating system的縮寫）

example: The teacher spent ten minutes explaining all the dos and don'ts in the classroom..
老師花了十分鐘解釋課堂紀律。

NONE: › the amount of medicine that you should take at one time
（一次的）劑量

example: "What's the dosage?" "One spoonful three times a day."
「服用多大劑量?」「每次一匙，一日三次。」
Do not exceed the recommended dosage.
一定不要超過醫生建議的劑量。

NONE: B2 a measured amount of something such as medicine
一劑
› to give someone a measured amount of medicine
給…開藥；給…用藥
B2 an amount or experience of something, often something bad or unpleasant
一些（糟糕或不愉快的事）
› UK slang a case of gonorrhoea (= a disease of the sexual organs)
淋病

example: a high/low dose
大／小劑量
a dose of penicillin
一劑盤尼西林
The label says to take one dose three times a day.
標籤上寫著每次一劑，每日三次。
20 or 30 of these pills would be a lethal dose (= enough to kill you).
二三十粒這樣的藥丸就會達到致命劑量。
The government received a hefty dose of bad news this week.
本周政府得到了許多壞消息。
UK She's got a nasty dose of flu.
她得了嚴重的流感。
informal He dosed himself (up) with valium to calm his nerves.
他服了鎮靜藥來緩解神經緊張。

NONE: › money
錢
› to sleep outside or in an empty building because you have no home and no money
（因無家無錢而）露宿；（在無人居住的空房子裡）過夜
› also doss down to sleep somewhere without a bed
（在沒床的地方）湊合著睡覺
› an activity that is easy or does not need hard work
舉手之勞，容易做的事情

example: She was dossing in doorways until the police picked her up.
她在被警方收容之前一直在門道裡過夜。
See also
dosshouse
Can I doss down at your house tonight, after the party?
今晚派對結束後我能在你家湊合過一夜嗎？

NONE: › to spend your time doing very little
混時間，無所事事

example: Come on, Peter, stop dossing around and get some work done.
快點，彼得，別無所事事的了，做點事吧。

NONE: › someone who has no home and no money
流浪者，流浪漢
› a very lazy person
懶漢，懶蛋
› an extremely cheap hotel for poor people who have no home in a city
（供無家可歸者住宿的）廉價旅店
› a set of papers containing information about a person, often a criminal, or on any subject
檔案，卷宗；彙編材料

example: The secret service probably has a dossier on all of us.
特工部門很可能有我們每個人的檔案。
